Core Features:

  • intellectually demanding combat system: no 1 button to parry, no iframes vs everything

  • Many characters: each with its own properties affecting how they perform in combat

  • Several classes: each with its own custom gameplay

  • Dynamic Stats: stats update based on your performance, level up/down in real-time

  • Difficulty modes: casual and ranked; ranked uses randomized movesets and combat inputs

  • Dynamic inventory: weapons represent movesets; pick up/drop AND equip/unequip them using
    inputs dynamically - no menus

  • Player-like Ai: enemies are coded to behave like players so it feels like multiplayer

  • Tutorials: step-by-step tutorials

  • Dynamic Lock On: move the character freely while locked on to a target

  • Keyboard/Mouse and Controller support: select your device in game to display the correct icons;
    also select your input layout; each difficulty mode has its own custom layout

  • Customize your UI: hide/show the panels for a more immersive experience

-----------

Important:

  • UE5 requires Microsoft C++ redistributables to be installed in order to run the game; the first time you open the game it checks to define whether to install Microsoft C++ redistributables or not: if it has to install it then a wizard will open and you will be guided through the installation - it takes less than a minute, no internet/downloading required. After the installation, the game will continue to load. If installing through Steam then Steam will automatically install the redistributables needed.

  • The game requires agreeing to a EULA before you can play the game.

  • If playing on the Steamdeck: please select the optimization settings for the Steamdeck when the game first opens so you can have a 60-90 fps experience with minimum quality loss on the Steamdeck. If you miss-select the initial optimization option, you can reselect it in the main menu, in the optimizations tab, in the initial settings tab.

-----------
